caveats: Collected during active development; compilation and other measurements may have overlapped. Not an isolated or dedicated host.

Process and basic measurements used the earlier stat RSS path. Later controlled-child validation proved a difference from statm/status RSS; these process rows must not be advertised as equal-RSS-content comparisons with sysinfo.

Early cold-case latency is recorded, but its retained-heap/RSS setup included an unused additional collector. Exclude those memory measurements from comparisons; the final harness removed the extra collector.
CPU cpu_hot and basic_hot include different freshness policies: sysinfo may return cached CPU values within 200ms while zsys collects live counters.
Requested 10000 processes stopped at actual 6340 under a monitored available-memory guard; this is not a 10000-process result.
raw_csv_preservation: CSV files are losslessly gzip-compressed. The archive retains environment, per-repeat summaries and raw samples.
